description: Edit one knowledge item of one of your Besidka projects. Notes can change title and text; every item can change its description, pinned state and, for PDFs, whether the original is sent as a PDF. The old text of a note is not kept. A changed note text is checked for prompt injection with your TypeSafe key only if you configured one, like add_project_note. Requires signing in (projects:write).

description.description: One-line description, up to 100 characters. null clears it

pinned.description: Whether chats always include this item

sendAsNativePdf.description: Send the original PDF to the model; PDF items only

name: update_project_knowledge_item
title: Update a project knowledge item
